name: DragonLeap v4
author: Darksidewalker (DaSiWa)
note: DragonLeap v4, the Lightspeed line (distilled) on JoyAI-Echo: image-to-video and video-to-video first, with sound; fp8 with the VAE included. Recommended: CFG 1, euler_cfg_pp, 8–10 steps (here on LTX's own 8-step schedule).
